description: Use to read your generation task by its private generationId. Completed results include a preview, name/description/tags in metadata, and pet.json and spritesheet. An animationRevision without acceptedAt must be explicitly accepted on its private preview before ZIP download, metadata editing or gallery submission. Other completed results include the ZIP. Website jobs may return awaiting_confirmation: open their private preview for the user to confirm the character. Edit metadata on the private preview before submitting for moderation; this read tool never confirms, edits or starts a paid retry. Failed results include error.code, message, hint and automaticRetry=false: stop polling and explain the failure. Do not use to list other tasks, publish results, or start another paid generation; use generate_pet only for a new user-requested task.
name: get_pet_generation
title: Get pet generation status and files
